The KHRA claims the **Union government** is ignoring the crisis faced by hotels while domestic consumers consume the majority of cooking gas.

recent_articles.title: Kochi Corpn.’s Fort Queen ferry to get a new lease of life - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Kochi Corporation** has proposed an estimated ₹27.29 lakh for the dry dock of its passenger boat, the Fort Queen, to revive its service. The corporation plans to reintroduce the boat as a temporary option during ro-ro vessel service gaps and is exploring partnering with the **Kochi Metro Rail Limited**.  However, **Kerala Shipping and Inland Navigation Corporation Ltd.** (KSINC) claims the boat was withdrawn due to safety concerns and viability issues, citing low daily earnings and logistical challenges. The corporation will also discuss renewing the boat's agreement and insurance at its upcoming council meeting.

recent_articles.title: Forest dept. seeks speedy ro-ro ferry access for snake rescuers in Kochi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala Forest department** has requested the **Kochi Corporation** to expedite access for snake rescue volunteers to the Vypeen–Fort Kochi ro-ro ferry service. The request, made by the Deputy Conservator of Forest, seeks special permission for direct entry into the service due to the emergency nature of their work.  The application will be considered at the next **Corporation Council** meeting. Rescued snakes are transported to shelters or the Social Forestry department in Edappally.

recent_articles.title: Three-day Mohiniyattam masterclass at Fort Kochi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala Kalamandalam**, a performance arts institution, is hosting a three-day masterclass on Mohiniyattam from May 22 to 24. recent_articles.title: CM Fadnavis’ bike ride draws Opposition ire - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, rode a motorbike to Vidhan Bhavan after Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** called for austerity measures. The move drew criticism from the Opposition who urged Ministers to use public transport instead.  **Sharad Pawar**, NCP SP president, questioned the timing of the austerity measures and demanded an all-party meeting with the Prime Minister. He also criticized the State Government ministers' language towards **Rahul Gandhi**, the Leader of Opposition in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Ten new MLCs sworn in at Maharashtra Vidhan Bhavan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ten newly elected members of the Maharashtra Legislative Council (MLC)** took their oaths on Thursday, May 14, 2026, following the end of nine sitting MLCs' terms. The new members include representatives from the **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP**.  The ceremony was presided over by **Legislative Council chairperson Ram Shinde** and attended by key figures like **Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar**, **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, and **Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit**. The Upper House currently has 22 vacancies, with the majority of seats held by the **BJP** due to their dominance in the Legislative Assembly.
